# awscc_scn_dataset (Resource)

Represents an AWS Supply Chain data lake dataset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance identifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the dataset.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the dataset.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the dataset.
- `partition_spec` (Attributes) The partition specification of the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_spec))
- `schema` (Attributes) The schema of the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the dataset.
- `created_time` (String) The creation time of the dataset.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The last modified time of the dataset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_scn_dataset.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the dataset

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_scn_dataset.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_scn_dataset.example "arn"
```
